---
title: "Multi-omics integration: Clinical + Proteomics + Metabolomics (MOFA2)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

Integrates three blocks for the the subjects shared between the
proteomics and metabolomics datasets:

- Clinical: the `mets_traits` panel (BMI, lipids, glycemic markers, etc.)
- Proteomics: the proteins (`Merged_proteomics_Data_soft_WithMetSGroup.csv`)
- Metabolomics: ~the metabolites (`Merged_Healthy_Mets_metabolites.RData`)

MOFA2 is used rather than DIABLO because the goal here is unsupervised
discovery of shared latent factors across the three blocks -- we then test
post-hoc whether any factor associates with `MetS_Group`
(Healthy/Mixed/Extreme), rather than forcing the model to optimize for that
label directly. A DIABLO example (supervised, outcome-driven) is included
at the end as a complementary follow-up.

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
# Run once, outside knitting
install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("MOFA2")
reticulate::py_install("mofapy2", envname = "r-reticulate")
BiocManager::install("mixOmics")
```

## Load and align the three blocks

```{r libs}
library(MOFA2)
```

```{r params}
id_col  <- "u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4"
age_col <- "u3talteru"
sex_col <- "u3csex"

# All results/plots from this script are written here, in a folder specific
# to this RMD, so outputs from different analyses never collide.
output_dir <- "multiomics_MOFA_DIABLO_MetS_results"
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

prot  <- read.csv("proteomics_MetS_analysis_results/Merged_proteomics_Data_soft_WithMetSGroup.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
load("merge_MetS_groups_vf_results/Merged_Metabolomics_Data_soft_WholePopulation_with_MetSGroup.RData") # loads: merged
metab <- Merged.Metabolomics.Data.soft.WholePopulation

protein_cols    <- colnames(prot)[grepl("^(sp|tr)__", colnames(prot))]
metabolite_cols <- colnames(metab)[which(colnames(metab) == "C0"):which(colnames(metab) == "Choline")]

mets_traits <- c("u3tbmi","u3twhrat","u3tsysmm","u3tdiamm",
                  "u3tglukfastn","u3tgluk2n","u3tinsfastn",
                  "u3thoma2_ir","u3lk_choln","u3lk_hdln","u3lk_ldln",
                  "u3lk_trin","u3l_hbavn","u3h_crp")

# Full set of clinical traits used to define the MetS extreme-search
# subclustering (archetype decomposition), kept here as a code -> readable
# label dictionary. mets_traits above still drives which clinical variables
# actually go into the MOFA/DIABLO "Clinical" block; this is used purely to
# relabel that block's feature names with human-readable trait names
# instead of raw variable codes (see the clin_mat rownames step below).
traits = c(
    Age = "u3talteru",
    Gender = "u3csex",
    Weight = "u3tgewi",
    Height = "u3tgroe",
    BMI = "u3tbmi",
    WHO_BMI_Category = "u3tbmiwho",
    WHR = "u3twhrat",
    WHR_Category = "u3twhratc",
    SBP = "u3tsysmm",
    DBP = "u3tdiamm",
    Hypertension = "u3twhoish",
    Fasting_glucose = "u3tglukfastn",
    Glucose_2h = "u3tgluk2n",
    Diabetes_WHO = "u3tdm110y15",
    Fasting_serum_insulin = "u3tinsfastn",
    Insulin_2h = "u3tins2n",
    Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF = "u3tmsidfup",
    HOMA_Beta = "u3thoma2_b",
    HOMA_Sensitivity = "u3thoma2_s",
    HOMA_IR = "u3thoma2_ir",
    Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki = "u3tquickin",
    Cholesterol = "u3lk_choln",
    HDL = "u3lk_hdln",
    LDL = "u3lk_ldln",
    TG = "u3lk_trin",
    Creatinine = "u3lk_krean",
    HbA1c = "u3l_hbavn",
    hsCRP = "u3h_crp"
  )
trait_label_lookup <- setNames(names(traits), traits)

trait_label <- function(code) {
  lbl <- trait_label_lookup[code]
  ifelse(is.na(lbl), code, lbl)
}

# Restrict to subjects present in BOTH omics blocks
common_ids <- intersect(prot[[id_col]], metab[[id_col]])
cat("Subjects with both proteomics and metabolomics:", length(common_ids), "\n")
```

```{r align}
prot_sub  <- prot[match(common_ids, prot[[id_col]]), ]
metab_sub <- metab[match(common_ids, metab[[id_col]]), ]

stopifnot(identical(prot_sub[[id_col]], metab_sub[[id_col]]))
```

## Build MOFA input (features x samples per block)

```{r build-blocks}
clin_mat  <- t(as.matrix(metab_sub[, mets_traits]))
prot_mat  <- t(as.matrix(prot_sub[,  protein_cols]))
metab_mat <- t(as.matrix(metab_sub[, metabolite_cols]))

# Relabel the Clinical block's feature names (currently raw variable codes,
# This is what MOFA's plot_weights(view = "Clinical", ...) and DIABLO's
# circosPlot()/selectVar() display, so downstream plots/tables show
# readable trait names instead of codes.
rownames(clin_mat) <- trait_label(rownames(clin_mat))

colnames(clin_mat) <- colnames(prot_mat) <- colnames(metab_mat) <- common_ids

# Standardize each block (z-score per feature) -- recommended for MOFA
# when blocks differ wildly in scale (clinical units vs. protein intensity
# vs. metabolite concentration)
zscore_rows <- function(m) t(scale(t(m)))
clin_mat  <- zscore_rows(clin_mat)
prot_mat  <- zscore_rows(prot_mat)
metab_mat <- zscore_rows(metab_mat)

mofa_data <- list(
  Clinical     = clin_mat,
  Proteomics   = prot_mat,
  Metabolomics = metab_mat
)

mofa_obj <- create_mofa(mofa_data)
```

```{r data-overview}
plot_data_overview(mofa_obj)
```

## Train MOFA

```{r mofa-options}
data_opts  <- get_default_data_options(mofa_obj)
model_opts <- get_default_model_options(mofa_obj)
model_opts$num_factors <- 15
train_opts <- get_default_training_options(mofa_obj)
train_opts$seed <- 42

mofa_obj <- prepare_mofa(mofa_obj, data_options = data_opts,
                          model_options = model_opts,
                          training_options = train_opts)
```

```{r mofa-train}
mofa_trained <- run_mofa(mofa_obj, outfile = file.path(output_dir, "MetS_MOFA_model_vf.hdf5"), use_basilisk = TRUE)
```

```{r mofa-train}
mofa_model_path <- file.path(output_dir, "MetS_MOFA_model_vf.hdf5")

if (file.exists(mofa_model_path)) {
  message("Loading pre-trained MOFA model from ", mofa_model_path)
  mofa_trained <- load_model(mofa_model_path)
} else {
  message("No saved model found -- training MOFA from scratch")
  mofa_trained <- run_mofa(mofa_obj, outfile = mofa_model_path, use_basilisk = TRUE)
}
```

## Link factors to MetS_Group

```{r factors-vs-group}
meta <- data.frame(
  sample     = common_ids,
  MetS_Group = factor(metab_sub$MetS_Group, levels = c("Healthy","Mixed","Extreme")),
  Age        = metab_sub[[age_col]],
  Sex        = factor(metab_sub[[sex_col]])
)
samples_metadata(mofa_trained) <- meta[match(samples_names(mofa_trained)[[1]], meta$sample), ]

factors_df <- as.data.frame(get_factors(mofa_trained, factors = "all")[[1]])
factors_df$MetS_Group <- samples_metadata(mofa_trained)$MetS_Group

# Kruskal-Wallis test: which factors differ across Healthy/Mixed/Extreme?
kw_p <- sapply(grep("^Factor", colnames(factors_df), value = TRUE), function(fc) {
  kruskal.test(factors_df[[fc]] ~ factors_df$MetS_Group)$p.value
})
sort(kw_p)
```

```{r factor-violin}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

mets_colors <- c("Healthy" = "darkolivegreen2", "Mixed" = "orange", "Extreme" = "red")

# Define pairwise comparisons (adjust order to match your factor levels)
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("Healthy", "Mixed"),
  c("Mixed", "Extreme"),
  c("Healthy", "Extreme")
)

factor_violin_plot = plot_factor(mofa_trained, factor = as.integer(sub("Factor", "", names(sort(kw_p))[1])),
            color_by = "MetS_Group", add_violin = TRUE, dodge = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mets_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mets_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons,
                      method = "wilcox.test",
                      label = "p.signif",     # shows *, **, ***, ns
                      size = 6) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test",
                      label.y.npc = "top",
                      size = 3) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

factor_violin_plot = factor_violin_plot +theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),        # remove the box
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))  # keep x/y axis lines

factor_violin_plot

ggsave("factor_violin_MetS_Group_stats.png", plot = factor_violin_plot,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)

ggsave("factor_violin_MetS_Group_stats.pdf", plot = factor_violin_plot,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600)
```

## Inspect top features driving the leading factor

```{r check-factor3-kw}
sort(kw_p)
kw_p["Factor3"]
```

```{r protein-name-cleanup}
# Extract a clean gene/protein symbol from IDs like:
extract_protein_name <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(id) {
    first_id <- sub("___.*$", "", id)                # drop extra "___"-joined accessions
    parts    <- strsplit(first_id, "__", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    name     <- parts[length(parts)]                 # e.g. "APOC4_HUMAN"
    sub("_HUMAN$", "", name)                         # -> "APOC4"
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

```{r top-factor-weights-proteomics}
top_factor <- as.integer(sub("Factor", "", names(sort(kw_p))[1]))
weights_prot <- get_weights(mofa_trained, views = "Proteomics", factors = top_factor)[[1]]

weights_df <- data.frame(
  feature = rownames(weights_prot),
  weight  = weights_prot[, 1],
  row.names = NULL
)
weights_df <- weights_df[order(-abs(weights_df$weight)), ]
top_features <- head(weights_df, 10)
top_features$protein_name <- extract_protein_name(top_features$feature)

write.csv(top_features,
          file.path(output_dir, paste0("top10_proteomics_weights_Factor", top_factor, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(weights_df,
          file.path(output_dir, paste0("All_proteomics_weights_Factor", top_factor, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

top_features
```

```{r top-factor-boxplots-proteomics, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)

# --- Pull (z-scored) expression of the top features + MetS_Group per sample ---
prot_top_expr <- as.data.frame(t(prot_mat[top_features$feature, , drop = FALSE]))
prot_top_expr$sample     <- rownames(prot_top_expr)
prot_top_expr$MetS_Group <- factors_df$MetS_Group[match(prot_top_expr$sample, rownames(factors_df))]

prot_top_long <- pivot_longer(prot_top_expr,
                               cols = all_of(top_features$feature),
                               names_to = "Protein", values_to = "Expression")

# Swap in the clean protein/gene symbol for display
prot_top_long$Protein <- extract_protein_name(prot_top_long$Protein)
prot_top_long$Protein <- factor(prot_top_long$Protein,
                                 levels = unique(extract_protein_name(top_features$feature)))

group_comparisons <- list(c("Healthy", "Mixed"), c("Mixed", "Extreme"), c("Healthy", "Extreme"))

# FIXED: underscore instead of hyphen
top_factor_boxplots_prot <- ggplot(prot_top_long, aes(x = MetS_Group, y = Expression, fill = MetS_Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 0.8, alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Protein, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mets_colors) +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = group_comparisons, method = "wilcox.test",
                      label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.01, hide.ns = TRUE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Z-scored protein expression",
       title = paste0("Top ", nrow(top_features), " Proteomics features driving Factor ", top_factor))

top_factor_boxplots_prot

# Save the plot
ggsave("top_factor_boxplots_prot.png",
       plot = top_factor_boxplots_prot,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600)


ggsave("top_factor_boxplots_prot.pdf",
       plot = top_factor_boxplots_prot,
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 600)

```

```{r top-factor-weights-metabolomics}
# --- Get top features by absolute weight, split TGs from everything else ---
weights_metab <- get_weights(mofa_trained, views = "Metabolomics", factors = top_factor)[[1]]

weights_metab_df <- data.frame(
  feature = rownames(weights_metab),
  weight  = weights_metab[, 1],
  row.names = NULL
)
weights_metab_df <- weights_metab_df[order(-abs(weights_metab_df$weight)), ]

is_TG <- grepl("^TG__", weights_metab_df$feature)

top5_TG    <- head(weights_metab_df[is_TG, ], 5)
top5_other <- head(weights_metab_df[!is_TG, ], 5)

# Combine and re-rank by |weight| for display order
top_features_metab <- rbind(top5_TG, top5_other)
top_features_metab <- top_features_metab[order(-abs(top_features_metab$weight)), ]

write.csv(top_features_metab,
          file.path(output_dir, paste0("top5TG_top5other_metabolomics_weights_Factor", top_factor, ".csv")),
          row.names = FALSE)

```

## Complementary supervised approach: DIABLO (mixOmics)

DIABLO directly maximizes correlation between the three blocks while
separating `MetS_Group`, making it the natural follow-up once MOFA has
identified that cross-omic structure exists, if the goal shifts to
building an explicit multi-omic classifier/signature.

```{r diablo-libs}
library(mixOmics)
```

```{r diablo-fit}
X <- list(
  Clinical     = t(clin_mat),
  Proteomics   = t(prot_mat),
  Metabolomics = t(metab_mat)
)
Y <- meta$MetS_Group[match(rownames(X$Clinical), meta$sample)]

diablo_design <- matrix(0.5, ncol = 3, nrow = 3,
                         dimnames = list(names(X), names(X)))
diag(diablo_design) <- 0

# Tune number of components / variables per block before final fit
# (keep small first run for speed; perf() and tune.block.splsda() are
diablo_model <- block.splsda(X, Y, ncomp = 2, design = diablo_design,
                              keepX = list(Clinical = c(10, 10),
                                           Proteomics = c(20, 20),
                                           Metabolomics = c(20, 20)))
```

```{r diablo-overview}
plotDiablo(diablo_model, ncomp = 1)
```

```{r diablo-indiv}
plotIndiv(diablo_model, legend = TRUE,
          title = "DIABLO: Clinical + Proteomics + Metabolomics")
```

```{r diablo-circos}
circosPlot(diablo_model, cutoff = 0.6,
           color.blocks = c("steelblue","darkorange","firebrick"))
```

```{r diablo-selectvar-proteomics}
selectVar(diablo_model, block = "Proteomics",   comp = 1)$Proteomics$name
```

```{r diablo-selectvar-metabolomics}
selectVar(diablo_model, block = "Metabolomics", comp = 1)$Metabolomics$name
```
